policy: Six deliberately selected diagnostic comparisons after outcome inspection, including wins, losses, two first-in-frozen-order untouched native controls, cross-engine transfer and one real recording. Not a population win-rate estimate. Historical human winners preserved exactly; every comparison includes a newly trained specialist output.

rows.label: Footstep reference
rows.reason: Familiar source where both previous Transfxr recreations were rejected. Directly compare old shared and new independent Footsteppr heads; new model is worse by matching distance.

rows.label: Rocket burst reference
rows.reason: New independent Boomr leads numerically. Preserve the exact older human winner rated roughly similar, and also include the older shared Boomr head.

rows.label: New short burst
rows.reason: First Boomr test control in the pretraining-frozen order. Both models are excluded from these exact controls; shared preset families. New improves numerical distance; no human adequacy assumed.

rows.label: New footstep
rows.reason: First Footsteppr test control in the pretraining-frozen order. New model improves numerical distance; assess whether this is audible.

rows.label: Wingbeat reference
rows.reason: Cross-engine reference from Whooshr; new Footsteppr is the lowest-distance option and old Footsteppr the strongest previous arm. Low-distance agreement case still needs human adequacy.

rows.label: Tagged recording · book close
rows.reason: Real tagged transfer test. Retain the exact earlier human winner and strongest current old shared head alongside the new specialist; the new head loses to old Footsteppr numerically.
